intro: You can take real courses from Harvard, Yale and MIT online for free. Most are free to audit on edX or Coursera; a certificate usually costs extra. Check each course page for the current terms.

free.title: The seven courses
free.body:
1. Harvard: CS50's Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python (edX)
  2. Harvard: Managing Happiness (edX)
  3. Harvard: Rhetoric, the Art of Persuasive Writing and Public Speaking (edX)
  4. Yale: Introduction to Negotiation (Coursera)
  5. Yale: The Science of Well-Being (Coursera)
  6. MIT: Becoming an Entrepreneur (edX)
  7. MIT: Understanding the World Through Data (edX)

Search the course name on edX or Coursera and choose "audit" to take it free.

free.title: Which one first
free.body:
• You want to understand AI properly: CS50 AI.
  • You sell or close deals: Negotiation, then Rhetoric.
  • You're starting something: Becoming an Entrepreneur.

free.title: Your AI study partner
free.body: Copy this inI'm taking [course]. Here are my notes from this week's lesson: [paste]. Explain the 3 most important ideas in plain English, give me one example from my business ([what you do]), then quiz me with 5 questions, one at a time.

free.title: Turn it into action
free.body: Copy this inBased on what I learned in [lesson], give me one thing to try in my business this week, how to measure it, and what to look for.

free.title: Stay on track
free.body:
Block two 45-minute sessions a week in your calendar. Finish one course before starting the next.

Use AI to explain and quiz you, not to do graded work for you.
